title: QA Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Sr QA Automation (Java Selenium/ Playwright)**  

**Location: Remote India**  

  

**Client Domain:** Product\-based company specializing in SaaS HRMS (Human Resource Management System) applications tailored for public sector organizations
**Job Summary:**
We are seeking a **seasoned Senior QA Engineer** with a strong background in **both automation and manual testing**, with proven expertise in **Selenium WebDriver** and **Java\-based test automation**. This role is pivotal to ensuring the quality and reliability of our SaaS\-based HRMS solutions. The ideal candidate will be responsible for leading QA efforts, driving test strategy, building scalable automation frameworks, and contributing to a high\-quality Agile development environment.
**Key Responsibilities:**
* Lead the end\-to\-end **automation testing efforts** using **Selenium WebDriver** with **Java**, and support key initiatives across **manual testing workflows**.
* Design, develop, and maintain robust, reusable **test automation frameworks** for web applications.
* Create and execute **comprehensive test plans**, **test cases**, and **manual/automated scripts** ensuring maximum coverage.
* Identify, isolate, and thoroughly document bugs, collaborating closely with developers for timely resolution.
* Integrate automated tests into **CI/CD pipelines** (Jenkins/GitHub Actions) and work closely with DevOps to streamline deployments.
* Perform **cross\-browser and cross\-platform testing** using tools such as **BrowserStack** or **Sauce Labs**.
* Conduct **API testing** (manual and automated) using **Postman**, **RestAssured**, or similar tools.
* Support **performance testing** efforts (using tools like **JMeter**) to ensure optimal application behavior under load.
* Champion best practices in **BDD/TDD**, test data management, defect reporting, and test metrics tracking.
* Actively contribute to **Agile ceremonies** (daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives, demos).
* Stay updated on emerging test tools and technologies to improve QA strategy and implementation.
* Mentor junior QA engineers and ensure QA standards are consistently met across projects.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**
* **6\+ years** of experience in **Software QA**, with **at least 3\+ years** in **Selenium WebDriver automation using Java**.
* Expertise in **Java programming** with strong OOP principles, especially in building automation scripts and frameworks.
* Solid hands\-on experience with **test automation frameworks**: TestNG, JUnit, and BDD tools like **Cucumber**.
* Strong command of **manual testing techniques**, including exploratory, regression, functional, and integration testing.
* Proficiency with **CI/CD tools**: Jenkins, Git, Docker.
* Experience with **API testing** and validation using **Postman**, **RestAssured**, or similar tools.
* Knowledge of **performance testing** tools like **JMeter** is a strong plus.
* Experience testing in **cloud\-based** or **virtual test environments** (BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, etc.).
* Familiarity with **Agile development** methodologies and DevOps practices.
* Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail and excellent problem\-solving skills.
* Exceptional communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams

title: Salesforce QA Engineer
description:
**Hello,**Hope you are doing well. My name is Chandrika, and I’m reaching out from Engineering Square — an IT consulting and outsourcing company that helps businesses find the right tech talent quickly.Please take a look at the job description below. If it looks like a good fit for you, just reply with your updated resume and your expected salary.**Salesforce QA Engineer — Manual and Regression Testing, Experience Cloud Portals, Lending (Remote, India)*****Full\-time · Remote (India)*** **Working time : 9:30 PM to 6:30 AM ISTSUMMARY**Engineering Square LLC (Fremont, CA) is hiring a Salesforce QA Engineer for an offshore pod embedded with a US solar manufacturer and its consumer\-financing affiliate. You manually test every change before it is released and run regression before every release — across Experience Cloud partner portals, a consumer\-lending platform on Salesforce and the Salesforce ↔ NetSuite integration. You own the test evidence on every story; nothing ships without your sign\-off. Full\-time, remote from India, with daily standups inside the client's US Pacific overlap window, camera on.**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* Manually test every Apex, LWC and Flow change against the acceptance criteria in the Jira ticket, plus exploratory testing around it
* Own and run the regression checklist across portals, lending flows and integrations before every release; keep it current; record the result as release evidence
* Test Experience Cloud portals: self\-registration and onboarding, login including federated SSO, sharing and guest\-user visibility, behaviour across partner roles, personas and devices
* Test lending flows: application intake, status visibility, document and e\-signature steps, post\-origination hand\-offs
* Test integrations end to end: NetSuite quote\-to\-cash sync, partner APIs, Platform Events — mappings, error handling, idempotency, record reconciliation across Salesforce, NetSuite and Snowflake
* Attach test cases, results, screenshots and defect logs to every story; log, triage and retest in Jira; keep test plans in Confluence; report status in the daily standup

**MUST HAVE (ALL OF THESE — NO EXCEPTIONS)**

* **Salesforce testing:** hands\-on manual functional and regression testing of Sales / Service Cloud — objects, validation rules, Flows, profiles, permission sets, record\-level security; clear, reproducible test cases and defect reports
* **Experience Cloud testing:** has tested at least one partner or customer portal — registration, role\-based access, sharing and guest visibility, multi\-persona and cross\-device checks. Portal testers go to the top of the list
* **Financial\-process testing:** has tested a lending, financial\-services or order\-to\-cash process on Salesforce; works on masked or synthetic data only
* **Integration testing:** Postman or equivalent, cross\-system record comparison, working SOQL, reading API and integration logs
* **Regression discipline:** builds and maintains a regression checklist, runs it completely before every release, produces auditable evidence
* **Delivery tooling:** Jira, Confluence, Git basics; familiarity with SFDX and GitHub Actions pipelines
* **Experience:** 1–3 years in software QA including at least 1 year testing Salesforce and at least one portal or financial\-process implementation
* **Certification:** none required; Salesforce Certified Administrator or Platform App Builder preferred; ISTQB Foundation, Experience Cloud Site Consultant or Provar a plus

**NICE TO HAVE**Test automation (Provar, Selenium, Playwright) in CI; Q2 Cloud Lending / Symphonix or another loan\-origination package; NetSuite or ERP exposure; SQL against Snowflake; Data Loader and Workbench; API automation; AI\-assisted test\-case generation on masked data; prior work with US enterprise clients from offshore.
